Popup window function used for months selection functions, to explain to the user that the selected departure month must be equal or prior to arrival month.

src.ui.widgets.sidebar.select_month(msg: str, index: int) → int¶

Get month from a dropdown list as integer, requiring get_month_from_str_int function to convert a month string to integer for further functions.

Parameters:

  • msg (str) – Message to be displayed aside the dropdown list

  • index (str) – The index of the preselected option on first render.

Returns:

Selected month as integer (bewteen 1 and 12)

Return type:

selected_month (int)

src.ui.widgets.sidebar.select_years(msg: str) → list[int]¶

Get year(s) from a multiselect dropdown. Initially, all years from the dataset are selected.

Parameters:

msg (str) – Message to be displayed aside the dropdown list

Returns:

Selected years from the initialized dataset.

Return type:

selected_years (list[int])
